title: Sex Estimation from Footwear Outsole Impressions Using CNN Transfer Learning and Interpretable Image Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2609.25386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Footwear outsole impressions are a common form of forensic pattern evidence, yet quantitative methods for estimating wearer attributes from these images remain relatively underdeveloped. We investigate binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions by comparing convolutional neural network (CNN) transfer learning with traditional feature-based classification. Using a publicly available outsole-impression dataset, we adopt a shoe-level training and test partition that keeps replicate scans of the same physical shoe together to reduce data leakage. We evaluate pretrained CNNs through end-to-end fine-tuning, frozen feature extraction followed by support vector machine classification, and hybrid feature fusion incorporating handcrafted, geometric, and metadata-derived descriptors. translated_title: 基于CNN迁移学习与可解释图像统计的鞋底印痕性别估计
translated_abstract: 鞋底印痕是一种常见的法庭模式证据，然而从这些图像中估计穿着者属性的定量方法仍相对不成熟。我们研究了从鞋底印痕进行二元性别估计的问题，将卷积神经网络（CNN）迁移学习与传统基于特征的分类方法进行比较。使用公开可用的鞋底印痕数据集，我们采用鞋级别的训练与测试划分方式，将同一实体鞋的重复扫描数据保持在同一集合中，以减少数据泄露。我们通过端到端微调、冻结特征提取后接支持向量机分类，以及融合手工特征、几何特征和元数据描述符的混合特征融合方法来评估预训练CNN。微调后的CNN实现了最强的整体预测性能，并显著优于在人工指定特征上训练的传统分类器。
tldr: 该研究通过鞋级别数据划分防止数据泄露，证明微调后的CNN迁移学习模型在从鞋底印痕估计穿着者性别方面显著优于传统基于特征的分类方法。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuned CNN transfer learning substantially outperforms traditional feature-based classifiers for binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions, with shoe-level data partitioning to prevent data leakage.
